name: Fundraising claims inconsistent with use of funds
description: Public appeals describe one cause while expenditure patterns show little programme spending or large payments to connected parties.
fp: May have innocent explanations; assess in context of customer profile and other indicators.

sources.text: FATF, Risk of Terrorist Abuse in Non-Profit Organisations (2014)
FATF, Best Practices on Combating the Abuse of Non-Profit Organisations (Recommendation 8) (2015; revised Nov 2023)
FATF Recommendation 8 and its Interpretive Note
